answer.headline: Conversion rate changed within normal overall variation, but Macintosh users experienced a significant product break.
explanation: While the site-wide conversion rate change remained within normal weekly variation, Macintosh users suffered a sharp drop in add-to-cart behavior after viewing products starting on Wed 13 Jan 2021.
Specifically, the add-to-cart after a product view for Macintosh dropped drastically compared to the rest of the site.
This localized drop negatively impacted the segment's overall performance despite the broader site trend remaining positive.
answer.next_step: Investigate the product page experience and recent frontend deployments for Macintosh users starting from 13 Jan 2021.
